title: Iman with Conviction: Aqeedah in the Face of the World
description: A pathway that moves your teenager (16-18) from inherited iman to a certainty rooted in conviction, steadfast before the world: grounding self-driven iman, confronting atheism and contemporary doubts, aqeedah as a compass for decisions, and life for a greater purpose.

primary_reference.info: ثلاثة الأصول والقواعد الأربع لابن عثيمين، العقيدة الطحاوية، أسئلة الأطفال الإيمانية، أصول الإيمان على فهم السلف

review_defects.why: The Arabic 'الإيمان الذاتي' likely means 'personal faith' or 'faith of the self', not 'self-driven iman' which implies the faith drives itself. The nuance is slightly altered.
